arms.T_D_coordinates: modal alpha / Delta of each encoder's own J frequencies (t96 rule)
arms.cells: mixed-verdict member x 3 seeds; member-clustered bootstrap, 10000 draws, PCG64 7201, DESCRIPTIVE
arms.cohort_note: E99 and JEPA were trained on inventory executions of the fit lineages, so only the held-out cohort is out-of-sample for them; 'all' is descriptive

costs.count: frozen TaskObjective: 1000 * clamp(pig presence, 0, 1) + sum over block slots of clamp(block presence, 0, 1)
costs.tie_free: pig presence (unclamped) - 0.1 * Euclidean displacement of the pig slot center (normalized screen units) between the stage's start carrier (position 0) and the endpoint carrier; lower is better

definitions.D: hybrid checkpoint, description-only: Delta fixed at Delta_D, alpha = argmax_alpha L[Delta_D, alpha]; Delta_D = the modal Delta of J's pooled per-seed step-pair frequencies (outcome-free; 225 is divisible by every Delta so Delta_D is always feasible)
definitions.F-1-continuous: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (1, continuous) at every step
definitions.F-1-macro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (1, macro) at every step
definitions.F-1-micro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (1, micro) at every step
definitions.F-15-continuous: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (15, continuous) at every step
definitions.F-15-macro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (15, macro) at every step
definitions.F-15-micro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (15, micro) at every step
definitions.F-5-continuous: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (5, continuous) at every step
definitions.F-5-macro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (5, macro) at every step
definitions.F-5-micro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (5, micro) at every step
definitions.J: hybrid checkpoint, joint argmax over the nine MatchedController logits at every step (logits with Delta > remaining masked to -inf inside the controller; argmax ties to the lower PAIRS index) = #92 hybrid-adaptive-e225
definitions.M: hybrid checkpoint, factorized selector from the same logits, no training: Delta* = argmax_Delta logsumexp_alpha L[Delta, alpha], alpha* = argmax_alpha logsumexp_Delta L[Delta, alpha]; pair (Delta*, alpha*)
definitions.T: hybrid checkpoint, temporal-only: alpha fixed at alpha_T, Delta = argmax_Delta L[Delta, alpha_T]; alpha_T = the modal alpha of J's pooled per-seed step-pair frequencies (outcome-free)

arms.rule: per inventory, better encoder, held-out cohort, tie-free cost: supported iff guards pass AND mean >= 0.02 AND lower > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff guards pass AND upper < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient

cohorts.fit: the 12 #77 predictor/controller lineages (the N1 dynamics shards)

audit.frames: the #77 build_n1_shot window rows of every shot: starts sorted({round(i * max(0, last - 60) / 3)}), 60 transitions, valid rows only, union per shot (for fit lineages exactly the shard frames)
audit.labels: #99 shot_labels = #77 build_n1_shot semantics: engine presence (active body), projected centers, cohort-v2 contact (symmetric) / supports (directed) with availability masks, native macro labels with availability masks
audit.phases: engine-only per shot: pre_contact = frames before the first bird contact with any non-bird, non-slingshot slot (all frames if none); settled = from the first frame >= onset after which steady-state is available and true to the end; cascade = the frames between

readouts.macro: gated macro value sigmoid(logit) x sigmoid(availability) >= 0.5 where the engine mask is available
readouts.micro: the predictor's gated micro value (symbolic_features: sigmoid(logit) x carrier presence of both slots x sigmoid(availability)) >= 0.5; contact on unordered pairs i < j, supports on ordered pairs, only where the engine relation mask is available
readouts.presence: carrier presence_probability >= 0.5 per slot against engine presence; all 18 slots

sources.Delta-alpha: heads on predictor.carrier(z_{p - Delta}, a, (Delta, alpha)) for every request; headline rows use alpha matched to the predicate level ({'presence': 'continuous', 'contact': 'micro', 'supports': 'micro', 'steady-state': 'macro', 'structure-unstable': 'macro'})
sources.encoder: heads on the encoded carrier z_p

audit.statistics: precision, recall, F1 from counts pooled over the cohort's frames, per seed, then mean over seeds; intervals: lineage-clustered percentile bootstrap (10000 draws, PCG64 7201, one resample shared by the seeds), DESCRIPTIVE

claim_boundary: readout fidelity on retained #77 N1 captures of 16 normal-mechanics lineages; decision-only ranking of retained engine-verdicted executions; no engine access, rendering, capture, closed-loop or competence claim; every interval is DESCRIPTIVE; nothing here edits the ICLR 2026 submission

controllers.window: first window (start 0, 60 transitions) of every fit shot of the #77 controller lineages

disclosure: Known before freeze: the unaudited probe numbers quoted in issue #100, every #77/#96/#99/#109 table (including the #99 E-arm held-out perception accuracies and ranking AUCs). No readout F1, JEPA outcome or new-checkpoint ranking statistic was computed before this freeze; the smoke asserts mechanics only.

encoders.E99: frozen #99 spatial slot parser (320x240, issue-99-slot-encoder-fix-v1 arm E) + the #99 E hybrid predictors; controllers trained here with the #77 controller recipe
encoders.F77: frozen issue-70 parser v6 (96x64) + frozen #77 N1 hybrid checkpoints and controllers
encoders.JEPA: jointly trained here: context encoder (spatial slot parser architecture) + EMA target encoder (stop-gradient) + CNNHybridPredictor, micro/macro heads and the issue-70 parser loss as auxiliary losses; controllers trained here with the #77 controller recipe

frame_cache.note: derived uint8 cache of fit-shot frames (320x240); rebuildable; not an input

guards.G1: F77 audit carriers replicate every valid #77 shard carrier row within 0.001
guards.G2: F77 rollout per-seed position_mse at t = 225 replicates the published #77 diagnostic summary for ['hybrid_continuous_h1', 'hybrid_continuous_h15', 'hybrid_continuous_h5', 'hybrid_macro_h15', 'hybrid_micro_h15'] within relative 0.001
guards.G3: F77 arms replicate the #96 records (count cost of every candidate of every F/J/M/T/D record) within 0.001, and the F77 T/D coordinates equal #96's
guards.G4: no held-out lineage shot in any JEPA/E99 training or controller window
guards.G5: 3 JEPA checkpoints at 9000 steps with finite losses; 6 controllers complete
guards.G6: the differentiable carrier of each trained JEPA encoder equals its adapter carrier within 0.0001 on five frames of issue-77-n1-001-a06
guards.G7: every micro/macro predicate has >= 20 positive engine labels in the held-out audit

jepa.architecture: context encoder = SpatialSlotParser (hidden 128, 2 attention layers x 4 heads, 320x240); target encoder = EMA copy, no gradient; predictor = CNNHybridPredictor

fit_data.rule: the #99 fit shots (every #77 N1 admissible branch of the 12 fit lineages and every verdict-bearing inventory execution of those lineages); labels from the #99 shot cache; verdicts never read

jepa.inference: the context encoder in the standard RepairedAdapter (same code path as F77/E99)
jepa.loss: #77 training_loss structure (4 local transitions + recursive, carrier bound .01) with targets from the target encoder (stop-gradient) + 0.1 x micro and macro head losses on predicted and context carriers for every request + 1.0 x issue-70 parser_loss on the context frames (class-balanced presence weights of the #99 encoder payload)

E99.encoder_training: #99: 12 epochs x 42344 frames, batch 64 (separate, before the predictor)
E99.predictor_training: #77 recipe: 9000 steps x 64 windows over the 745 #99 fit shots

F77.predictor_training: #77 recipe: 9000 steps x 64 windows over 2409 lineages

JEPA.encoder_training: joint: 9000 steps x 64 windows (256 context frames per step)
JEPA.predictor_training: joint: 9000 steps x 64 windows over the 745 #99 fit shots

claims.C1_bird_presence_frame80_below_0.5: every bird slot's carrier presence < 0.5 at frame 80
claims.C2_pig_presence_frame80_below_0.5: the pig slot's carrier presence < 0.5 at frame 80
claims.C7_lineage_009_positions_mislocalised: mean engine-present slot center error > 0.05 on the lineage-009 frames with a gated edge > 0.5

changing any recipe after training starts

questions.Q1_readout_fidelity: how well do presence, contact, supports, steady-state and structure-unstable read out of each encoder's carriers and one-step predictions, against engine labels, per phase; are the 2026-09-25 probe numbers reproduced?
questions.Q2_readout_target: does at least one encoder reach macro F1 >= 0.7 and micro edge F1 >= 0.5 on held-out lineages?
questions.Q3_jepa_vs_frozen: how do the jointly trained JEPA encoder's rollout error (#77 diagnostic protocol) and readout F1 compare with the frozen-encoder carriers (F77, E99)?
questions.Q4_alpha_effect: J - T and J - D per inventory on the better encoder (#96 arms, rerun here)

readout_target.better_encoder: among encoders meeting the target (all encoders if none): the highest mean of held-out macro F1 and micro edge F1; ties to the ENCODERS order
readout_target.macro_f1: mean of the steady-state and structure-unstable F1 (encoder source, all phases, held-out)
readout_target.micro_edge_f1: mean of the contact-edge and supports-edge F1 (encoder source, all phases, held-out)
readout_target.rule: supported iff guards pass AND some encoder has seed-mean macro F1 >= 0.7 and micro edge F1 >= 0.5 (point estimates, as declared in the issue); not_supported_by_this_experiment iff guards pass and none does; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient

rollout.contrast: JEPA - F77 and JEPA - E99 per request: state-clustered paired bootstrap of seed-mean per-state differences, DESCRIPTIVE
rollout.headline: position_mse and engine_position_mse at t = 225, all nine requests
rollout.protocol: #77 diagnostic (tab:res:rollout): held-out states with >= 1 admissible branch, every admissible candidate, one context carrier per state (frame 0 of the lowest-ordinal branch, batch-1 parse by the encoder's adapter), recursive fixed-request rollout to 600 with no truth resets; errors at t in [15, 30, 60, 150, 225, 600] against the encoder's own parsed carrier of the candidate's frame (diag.field_errors, target-availability masks) and against the engine-projected centers of engine-present slots (engine_position_mse); mean over candidates, then states, then seeds

smoke_evidence.reading: infrastructure assertions only; nothing kept; no verdict joined; no F1 computed
